## Seven criterion verdicts

| Criterion | Verdict | Independent assessment |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1. Current versus required; evidence attribution | **ACCEPT** | Proposal §1 accurately separates the seven registered regions from the bounded playable world, Dart-only campaign fabrication from four seeded fixture vessels, the adopted nine recipes from ECO's 39 proposed recipes, and C01–C04 from the missing campaign. Registry counts, current survival/protection limits and generic Hush/Mantle handling match source. Historical geometry/CPU figures retain POLISH-1C attribution; Opus's SwiftShader observations retain software-renderer limits. No registration, fixture or old measurement becomes campaign/GPU proof. |
| 2. Complete integrated scope | **ACCEPT** | §§1–2 and §8 retain seven habitats, three walkable islands, six meaningful hull roles and Bobbin. The matrix supplies a question, observable geography, material tier, loadout choice, payoff and physical return/recovery for each expedition. Creel/service stops and carrier/Mantle remain independently viable; Hush/Spindle/Dart are useful without becoming universal prerequisites. Early Creel habitation and substantial remaining carrier use are explicit. Food/no thirst, evasion/deterrence, retained knowledge and repeated loss remain required; optional records and travel/harvest padding cannot replace content. |
| 3. Canopy–Basin benchmark before breadth | **ACCEPT** | §3 makes OS2-04/06 concrete: physical heightfield versus float32 triangles, actor support, near-plane corners, interaction/LOS origins and work faces must agree. It diagnoses intersection versus featureless terrain before prescribing a camera fix. The 53 m warning lane versus cover topping out at 73 m is a real source mismatch to resolve through authored geometry/trigger reconciliation. Matched views cover retreat, cover, lab approaches, depletion, floor contact, Basin forks, world edge and cockpit/HUD composition. Emission-origin cues expire and do not track hidden animals. The batch additionally requires useful preparation, ordinary outbound/return/recovery and reload. Budgets are proposed trials; acceptance does not require unavailable dedicated-GPU measurements now. |
| 4. Feasible seams, ownership and dependency order | **ACCEPT** | §§4–5 start with real APIs, then propose small capability/refuge/campaign and region-handle extensions. No general quest/ECS framework is required. One A1 core owner returns exports/state/migration for root inspection and a committed baseline; disjoint A2 render and A3 UI/audio/app consumers then work from that same baseline without unfinished peer dependencies. Composition precedes the complete-batch pair. Root plus two consumers/reviewers fits four slots; a stage-exit pair plus Opus also fits with root. The broad A1 paths, camera/targeting amendments and exact APIs are explicitly proposed, with root retaining dispatch/interface authority. |
| 5. Save, economy, conservation and recovery | **ACCEPT** | §§6–7 address actual closed source/facility/provenance/capacity/campaign domains, old-version validation before migration, one-time new content, earned identities/receipts/depletion and the existing 2-CU installed trim. Horizontal/vertical bounds, old safe poses, berth transactions and immediately saveable paused commands are included. Registered refuge safety and occupied-parent/attached-craft conservation are explicit dependencies. Every hazardous route needs starter-accessible staging, a complete tether route and tow or physical salvage/canister outcome before activation. First stock precedes its protection, and suit/bench/exit/return requirements accompany hull depth. Draft cargo/stock arithmetic, M1 staged transactions and ordinary route margins remain distinct. |
| 6. M2 ending; M3 authored campaign; M4 polish | **ACCEPT** | §§2 and 8 require both strategies through an actual functional canonical ending in M2, including consequential procedure and resolution. M3 retains every C01–C15 placement, independent foreshadowing, voices, fuller scenes, ecology and dedicated hull missions. M4 reserves the post-M3 critic, corrections and final checks. I read the protected canon and appendix and checked chronology/accounting, physical causality, final-state ordering, redundant essential information and early discovery; no contradiction requiring a spoiler finding was found. Optional personal playback is not machinery permission, and remote-visible facts are retained. |
| 7. Review gates, playable evidence and exceptions | **ACCEPT** | §8 requires author checks/root inspection, independent non-author Astra xhigh and Sol6.1/max on each frozen full batch, correction rounds with prior findings, and a separate integrated M2 gate. It retains all stage Opus advice/Sol correction/fresh verification loops and the dedicated post-M3 Astra critic. Concrete M2 evidence covers both New Game-to-ending strategies, Creel-first without Dart, all hull roles, earned carrier/refuge/berth behavior, interrupted transfers, deep and repeated recovery, old saves and second-session reload. Human duration/enjoyment, real-mouse comfort, audible mix and representative-GPU evidence remain qualified; a missing ending, rescue route or functional blocker is expressly not an evidence exception. |

## Source and retained-evidence checks

Read `AGENTS.md` and `STATUS.md` first, then `PLAN.md`, `CONTRACTS.md`, the revised build input and its world/fleet/story/graphics/delivery/integration pointers, `GLOSSARY.md`, the settled map and historical tracker. Also read both M2 briefs, [root inspection/objections](M2-DIRECTION-ROOT.md), [Opus R2](OPUS-STAGE1-R2.md) and [disposition](OPUS-STAGE1-R2-DISPOSITION.md), [M1 carrier disposition](../evidence/M1-CARRIER-INTEGRATION.md), [ECO proposal](../design/ECONOMY_CANDIDATE.md), its quantities/checker and [adopted M1 delta](../design/M1-PLAY-ECONOMY.json). Protected canon was used only for internal consistency checking. I did not contact or wait for the active consultant or another reviewer.

Independent source inspection confirmed the following material claims:

- [Registry](../../../src/content/registry.ts): seven regions, six piloted hull IDs, 20 sources (16 material/four food), five placed material families, nine recipes, C01–C04, Dart-only hull output and cover top at −73 m. A read-only Node import asserted these counts, checked the missing ceramic/core/lattice deposits and recomputed the adopted public starter spend as alloy/glass/membrane **16/11/12**. It also checked **35 local candidate-document links**; all resolve.
- [World](../../../src/sim/world.ts): physical bounds X −76..188 / Z −184..66 give **264 × 250 m**. The rendered terrain grid separately spans 300 × 290 m; it does not enlarge playable bounds. `terrainHeight` blends every submerged material source into the surface, making source additions physical changes. [Terrain refinement](../../../src/render/terrainSurface.ts) is limited to the old island approach, not a ready general-world solution.
- [Save codec](../../../src/save/codec.ts) and [validator](../../../src/save/validation.ts): schema2/expedition.3 reads foundation.1 and expedition.2 through explicit paths; exact source count, four facilities, expected blueprints/provenance, fixed capacities and Dart-only earned fleet remain enforced. World Y is −200..100; general vectors are bounded to ±1000. A content-tag bump alone cannot implement world expansion safely.
- [Modules](../../../src/sim/modules.ts), [progression](../../../src/sim/progression.ts), [survival](../../../src/sim/survival.ts) and [movement](../../../src/sim/step.ts): existing trim is an ordinary identified hold item consuming 2 CU/one socket; personal protection is 60/150, pressure damage reads initial hull depth, and Hush/Mantle share generic handling. Food's 70 points per 35 active minutes is an implemented drain rule, not pacing validation.
- [Carrier](../../../src/sim/carrier.ts), [recovery](../../../src/sim/recovery.ts), [renderer](../../../src/render/renderer.ts) and [expedition art](../../../src/render/expedition.ts): four fixture craft, local transforms and prepared/lock/full-path transfer checks exist; earned carrier construction/registration does not. Recovery is Dart-specific with one staging point, a 230 m eligibility limit, direct guide advancement on approach and swept hull towing. Rendering eagerly constructs current scene content; Hush/Mantle lack dedicated art branches. These support the proposal's gap classifications, not acceptance of future systems.
- [POLISH-1C evidence](../evidence/POLISH-1C.md): **301,707 vertices / 485,460 triangles, 102 meshes / 18 materials and one 822.90 ms NullEngine scene-construction sample** match the proposal's historical references. I did not repeat that measurement or infer actual draw calls/GPU performance from it.

I hash/size-verified and locally viewed only four retained Opus payloads under `/tmp/siltwake-opus-stage1-r2/`, against its existing manifest: `frames/14-ribs-landmark.png`, frame27 ending `mve9o427-2348ef51.png`, frame44 ending `mve9w6b2-7e766f81.png`, and frame48 ending `mvea0xno-3f2da0b6.png`. They support the proposal's contrast between the readable reef and crowded cockpit, near-floor wash and sparse 53 m Canopy view. This is still inspection, not browser activity, continuous video viewing, fresh play or verification of all 220 archive payloads. Original artifacts were not modified.

## Checks actually run and limits

Real commands used included `pwd`, `git status --short --branch`, `git rev-parse HEAD`, `git log -3 --format='%H %s'`, `rg --files`, targeted `rg -n`, `cat`, `nl -ba`, `sed -n` and `wc -l` for the sources above, plus:

```sh
git diff --name-status 89e271bb8f98bef413afa9c77d8ceabff67e9790 4478b806b4ce2d409daab18c74aa3666137c6f6f
git diff --exit-code 4478b806b4ce2d409daab18c74aa3666137c6f6f HEAD -- docs/build/design/M2-DIRECTION-PROPOSAL.md docs/build/design/spoilers/M2-NARRATIVE-GATES.md
git diff --name-only d9aaf6356cb320f283887922abf97ed8bdc54f59 HEAD -- . ':!docs/**' ':!.scratch/**' ':!prompts/**'
node docs/build/design/check-economy.mjs
git diff --check
```

The first diff lists exactly the two authorized additions; the next two are empty, exit0. The unchanged economy checker exits0 for its 39-recipe/33-patch catalog, eight strategy/starter/optional scenarios, six independent optional purchase branches, five budgeted failures and 20 numeric salvage/rebuild transactions per scenario, plus six rejection fixtures. Its output explicitly leaves routes, return margins, rescue topology, collision, renewal and human balance unverified. It does not include the adopted M1 delta; the proposal correctly requires recomputing the combined ledger before runtime adoption.

Additional real checks were a `node --input-type=module` here-doc for the source inventory/adopted spend/local links, and `python3` here-docs reading this reviewer's runtime records and verifying the four retained image hashes/sizes. Their exact inputs are retained in the reviewer rollout above. The initial `python` command was unavailable; the runtime-record read was rerun successfully with `python3`. No test/build/gameplay pass is invented: I did not run `npm` checks, start a game/server, or execute an M2 route. No new performance, audio, mouse, human-duration or enjoyment evidence exists from this review.

## Decisions still reserved for implementation

These are already stated in the candidate/root objections and do not require changing this direction proposal:

1. After stage1 closure, root must freeze exact schema/content tags, historical definitions, actual exports and exclusive paths. A smaller core contract slice is reasonable if A1 migration grows; camera/targeting/rib changes and legacy-test amendments need explicit ownership.
2. Validate the combined M1/ECO ledger, source placement, first-exit protection, cargo compatibility and complete rescue routes in the implemented batches. In particular, retain the difference between Dart180 reaching first Basin stock and personal350 needed to exit, without converting that benchmark into a permanent Dart prerequisite.
3. Trial the density/residency/performance budgets against the composed game. Do not unload authoritative pursuit/transactions or sacrifice functional cover/hosts to satisfy an unmeasured count. Both complete strategies, earned carrier timing and repeated-loss conservation remain future playable acceptance obligations.

No minimal correction is requested. The independent verdict is **ACCEPT / ACCEPT / ACCEPT / ACCEPT / ACCEPT / ACCEPT / ACCEPT**. This report's ownership is released on return; no owned process, tab, server, child or other live resource remains.
